## 17.4 Human Roles (Minimal & High-Leverage)

DTM is designed to run profitably with **≤ 5 humans** at scale.

### Role 1: Founder / Strategist (You)

**Never delegate:**
• Vision
• Offer design
• Pricing logic
• Key client relationships
• Strategic pivots

**Hard limits:**
• No task under $500/hr value
• No daily ops
• No manual reporting

• 8–12 active Strategic/Sovereign clients

**Owns:**
• Client communication
• KPI alignment
• Renewal & expansion signals

**Does NOT:**
• Build assets
• Run ads
• Touch automations
